title: Power Plant Manager
text:
**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced, results-driven **Plant Manager** to lead all daily manufacturing and facility operations. In this role, you will oversee production performance, quality standards, equipment maintenance, and environmental health and safety (EHS/OSHA) compliance. You will manage plant-level budgets, drive improvement initiatives, and build a high-performing, accountable team.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership, coordination, direction and oversight of management/supervisory personnel assigned to power generation facilities.
* Review, analyze, plan, coordinate, and lead all activities within the Operations Department.
* Ensure plant availability and execution of operating and maintenance schedules in conjunction with Plant Staff. • Enforce OSHA, NERC and Environmental permit regulations, investigating accidents, and tracking safety violations.
* Improve processes to optimize asset performance.
* Direct preventive/predictive maintenance programs and coordinate major plant overhauls or planned outages to minimize downtown.
* Establish goals to provide continual improvement in operational productivity and quality.
* Facilitate operational and process engineering changes as necessary.
* Provide oversight to foster an environment that encourages employee involvement.
* Provide guidance and support to ensure safety, environmental, and regulatory compliance.
* Coordinate fulfillment of obligations to its contract counterparties and the energy markets.
* Prepare and manage annual operating and labor budgets, vendor contracts, parts inventory and cost control initiatives.
* Hire, train, schedule and evaluate plant operators, engineers and maintenance staff.
* Ensure compliance with all company standards, practices and policies.
* Oversee the administration of all computerized databases, file systems, and reporting systems for the collection and processing of plant related data.
* Perform other duties as deemed necessary by Owner and VP of Operations.

**Skills**

* A bachelor's degree in business or engineering discipline or equivalent experience preferred.
* A minimum of 10-15 years’ experience in hydroelectric, steam and/or electric power plant operations.
* A minimum of 5 years’ management experience.
* Practical knowledge of power generation systems, boilers, gas turbines, and equipment maintenance.
* Mechanical knowledge, electrical systems familiarity, and engineering troubleshooting ability; technical proficiency with plant equipment and P&IDs.
* Understanding of water and wastewater treatment, pipelines, oil and gas operations, safety regulations, and environmental compliance.
* Readiness to follow emergency response procedures and use PPE and respiratory protection correctly.

*We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

Pay: $165,000.00 - $210,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* AD&D insurance
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* On-the-job training
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Management: 5 years (Required)

Ability to Relocate:

* Brush, CO 80723: Relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person
